newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Centaur lifts gold resource estimate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Centaur lifts gold resource estimate.

text.p: Centaur Mining and Exploration Ltd said on Tuesday the resource estimate at the Quarters prospect was increased by 800,000 ounces, boosting the resource estimate for the Mount Pleasant, Ora Banda deposit in Western Australia.
Centaur said the total resource estimate at Mount Pleasant and Ora Banda now stood at 3.9 million ounces from 39.6 million tonnes at an average grade of 3.0 grams per tonne of gold.
It said the current hedging and commitments, including flat forwards and put options, total 415,350 ounces at an average price of A$523 per ounce.
Centaur said gold production at Mount Pleasant totalled 33,137 ounces in the three months to December 31.
It said gold output during the March quarter at Mount Pleasant will increase with the start of mining at Quarters.
Centaur is part of the stable of mining companies controlled by mining entrepreneur Joseph Gutnick. At 1.05 p.m. (0205 GMT), Centaur shares were three cents up at A$2.08.
